escalations.why: risk.Drawdown in docs/packages/risk/contract.md has fields ticker, depth, peak_date only, but TC-08 (tests/fixtures/risk/TC-08/expected.json) and M1-T20's acceptance ('depth within 1e-12, both dates exact') need a trough_date: str as well. Freezing the type as written leaves M1-T20 a seam it cannot express (Review: Critical); adding the field myself would freeze more than contract.md says. Proposed Revise: add 'trough_date: str' to risk.Drawdown (invariant: peak_date <= trough_date; both are dates of the returns, base_date allowed for the peak), and its sample. Everything else in contract.md matches the TC fixtures.

Conformance case 'test_load_prices_keeps_only_the_requested_tickers' (tests/contracts/test_mdata_contract.py): the fake returns only BOLT for load_prices(prices.csv, ['BOLT']); the real mdata.load_prices returns ('ACME','BOLT'). Cause: packages/mdata/src/mdata/validate.py::validate_rows only raises KeyError for a missing requested ticker and never drops rows of unrequested tickers. Knock-on: risk.vol_series case 'keeps_only_the_requested_tickers' fails on the real provider too, and risk.risk_report(tickers=[...]) returns every ticker. Fix belongs in mdata.validate (not in M1-T21 Writes): filter latest to the requested tickers. M1-T21 tests/system/test_e2e.py and tests/unit/risk/test_risk_report.py hold the failing cases.

M1-T22 acceptance 3 asks to run the load_prices contract cases on the real provider marked xfail naming M1-T23, but (1) floor_guard flags any new pytest.mark.xfail in a test file as test-skipped (CR-03) and CONSTRAINTS.md Exceptions has no row for tests/contracts/test_mdata_contract.py, so gate fails; (2) xfail_strict=true makes those cases XPASS-fail once M1-T23 lands, yet M1-T23's Writes omit tests/contracts/test_mdata_contract.py (protected, CR-09), so it cannot remove the xfail its acceptance says it removes; without xfail the real side fails today (validate_rows does not filter tickers yet, so the subset and requested-ticker cases fail). Fix: either add a CR-03 Exceptions row for tests/contracts/test_mdata_contract.py expiring with M1-T23 and add that file to M1-T23's Writes, or move the real-provider parametrization (M1-R03) into a task after M1-T23 and let M1-T22 freeze the fake, the subset fixture and the cases against the fake only
